claims: Continue phenylephrine infusion for hemodynamic support and titrate to maintain adequate mean arterial pressure, given recent systolic pressures of 89 mmHg.
Obtain arterial blood gas to reassess acid-base status and oxygenation given venous pCO2 59 mmHg, pH 7.35, and lactate 2.3 mmol/L.
Monitor serum creatinine and urine output closely for worsening renal function given creatinine rising from 1.9 to 2.2 mg/dL and BUN 61 mg/dL.
Continue insulin therapy with frequent glucose monitoring to manage hyperglycemia, as fingerstick glucose remains 265-287 mg/dL.
Monitor hemoglobin and hematocrit for further anemia and need for transfusion, given hemoglobin 8.9-9.3 g/dL and hematocrit 27-29%.
Assess and manage agitation and delirium with non-pharmacologic measures and consider antipsychotic therapy as needed, given Richmond-RAS +3 and CAM-ICU positive.
Monitor coagulation status with repeat INR and PTT, given INR 1.3-1.6 and PTT 30.9-33.6 sec, and continue vitamin K as ordered.
Evaluate and treat pain with multimodal analgesia, given reported severe pain level 9.
Monitor electrolytes and renal function, including sodium 130-136 mEq/L and phosphate 4.5-5.6 mg/dL, and replace as needed.
Maintain venous thromboembolism prophylaxis with mechanical or pharmacologic methods as appropriate, given immobility and bed rest.
